g.text: GALINI / L03 / bridge construction coordinate sections
Reserved supports, abutments and deck thickness / no structural engineering or compiled acceptance
BR-M / market bridge
Floor +4; deck thickness 0.60; scenic bed -6. Full rock-bank
abutments at both ends; two masonry pier assemblies at X [58,
70]. Clear floor width is 6 m, with .35 m external parapets.
The upper path bends in plan; this is its east-west coordinate
projection, not a false straight-route claim.
Continuous masonry arch/abutment language comes from the
inspected real bridge photo. Arch soffit shaping and
decorative relieving arches remain architectural modeling
choices. The declared supports reserve real volume and cannot
be omitted in AML; no engineering capacity is inferred.
BR-U / bent civic bridge
Floor +8; deck thickness 0.70; scenic bed -6. Full rock-bank
abutments at both ends; two masonry pier assemblies at X [61,
70]. Clear floor width is 6 m, with .35 m external parapets.
The upper path bends in plan; this is its east-west coordinate
projection, not a false straight-route claim.
Continuous masonry arch/abutment language comes from the
inspected real bridge photo. Arch soffit shaping and
decorative relieving arches remain architectural modeling
choices. The declared supports reserve real volume and cannot
be omitted in AML; no engineering capacity is inferred.
All bridge ground is inaccessible scenery. Neither bridge lies over another playable floor. Upper south screen is 2.4 m except W02; other bridge edge guards are 1.1 m. Roof-on
and opposite-bank compiled captures must verify complete supports and enclosure.
